rows.translation_en: Whom would you like to hear?
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.

rows.translation_en:
Can you really accept
an ending like this?
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.

rows.translation_en:
Please return
to a peaceful everyday life.
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.

rows.translation_en:
You must have realized by now
who's behind this whole farce.
Don't you want to slap them at least once?
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.

rows.translation_en:
But rotten as our enemy is, she's heaven's highest god.
You can't win. She can't die, after all.
And if you challenge her...
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.
review_notes: Kitsuto's opponent is the highest heavenly deity; immortality, not mere combat superiority, makes the fight unwinnable in his claim.

rows.translation_en:
You'll never return to the normal world.
If that doesn't bother you,
I'll take you somewhere interesting.
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.
review_notes: No-return warning preserved explicitly; sentence begins by completing 0:4.

rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.

rows.translation_en:
This matters, so I'll say it again.
You can never return to the normal world.
Think very carefully about what that means.
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.

rows.translation_en:
Now, let's see
just how real your resolve is.
...And on that note, heh heh...
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.

rows.translation_en: Save your progress up to this point?
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.

rows.translation_en:
Everyone of the %@ clan,
welcome to Hidden Kyoto, home of the dead and asuras!!
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.
review_notes: Hidden Kyoto is the project localization of the postgame Ura Kyoto; dead and asura inhabitants retained.

rows.translation_en:
The long, painful battle is finally over.
Congratulations.
And thank you, from the bottom of my heart!!
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.

rows.translation_en:
The two dreadful curses
will fade away naturally
when the hatred and sorrow disappear.
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.
review_notes: Two curses end naturally once hatred and grief disappear; not an immediate mechanical claim that a boss fight removes them.

rows.translation_en:
Now, I sincerely hope
that you will return as soon as possible
to a peaceful everyday life.
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.

rows.translation_en: Can you let bygones be bygones?
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.

rows.translation_en:
May prosperity and peace last
forever for all your descendants.
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.

Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.

rows.translation_en:
Keep going, %@ %$!!
Your history always
begins with you.
rows.context: Post-ending choice between Kitsuto's challenge to the heavenly mastermind and Hiruko's offer of peaceful closure; Itsuka's encouragement follows. Kitsuto warns twice that entering Hidden Kyoto is irreversible. No game save is performed by editing this text.
review_notes: Itsuka addresses the clan head with both surname and given-name placeholders in order.

rows.translation_en:
Let's believe in tomorrow
with a bang!!
